title: Round robin
summary: Time slices and a queue of ready processes.
hints: Keep a circular queue of process numbers. Pop the first, run it for `min(quantum, remaining)`, advance the clock.

AFTER running, first push every process whose arrival time is now `<= t` (in arrival order), and only THEN push the process just preempted (if it has time left). If the queue is empty, jump the clock to the next arrival.
